text: 123 Guidance for national tuberculosis programmes on the management of tuberculosis in children Any equipment that will be reused must be disinfected and sterilized before use for a subsequent patient. References 1. Laboratory services in tuberculosis control. Part II: Microscopy. Geneva, World Health Organization, 1998 (WHO/TB/98.258). 2. Zar HJ et al. Sputum induction for the diagnosis of pulmonary tuberculosis in infants and young children in an urban setting in South Africa. Archives of Disease in Childhood, 2000, 82:305-308.
